title: F2 Counter Initial Step Agreement
statement: For every Boolean list $x$, natural number $i<|x|$, and Boolean list $bs$, the one-step successors of the configurations with state $0$ and input-head position $i+1$ and with state $1$ and input-head position $i+2$ are equal, when both have work-tape head at position $0$, tape containing $bs$, and empty output.
